title: Just B | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Just B - Lakefront Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool and Dock Favorite Features:- Lakeview- Beachview
description_expanded: Just B - Lakefront Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool and Dock   Favorite Features: - Lakeview - Beachview - Private Covered Pool - Private Dock - Elevator - Event-Friendly - 3 Walk to Beach More about Just B: Nestled along the pristine shores of Grayton Beach, Florida, this luxurious lakefront beach house is a masterpiece of coastal elegance. Surrounded by the serenity of nature and the shimmering waters of a rare dune lake known as Western Lake, Just B offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and tropical tranquility. Guests will enjoy lake access, a private pool that can be heated, a private dock, and an elevator. The property is spacious and can comfortably accommodate up to 22 guests, making it ideal for multi-family vacations and group retreats. The open-concept living space is tastefully furnished with a coastal palette, comfortable seating, and stylish decor that reflects the laid-back charm of the Gulf Coast. Vaulted ceilings and large windows provide a light and airy feel, while picturesque lake views immediately melt away all your worries and bring zen back to the surface. The living room serves as a welcoming and cozy retreat, designed for comfort, and offering space for everyone to gather for a movie or conversation.  Impeccably designed, the gourmet kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, a five-burner gas stove, stunning granite countertops, an expansive breakfast bar accommodating six, and is fully equipped with all the essentials for crafting culinary masterpieces. Adjacent to the kitchen, guests can enjoy a meal at the dining table while enjoying the view of the lake. The balcony is designed with a focus on maximizing the lakefront experience. It features a spacious and well-furnished area, providing ample room for lounging, dining, and entertaining. This inviting outdoor space offers a front-row seat to the breathtaking views of Western Lake, creating a serene retreat for relaxation and enjoyment. Two dining sets on the balcony allow for al fresco meals with a stunning backdrop.  Boasting a covered pool, guests can enjoy a refreshing swim or simply lounge by the poolside, all while being shielded from the elements. Additionally, this property comes with a private dock, granting you direct access to the lake allowing guests to enjoy various water activities such as kayaking, paddleboarding, or simply lounging by the water's edge. Just B is equipped with an elevator that reaches every floor, adding a touch of luxury and ensuring easy access to all levels of the property.  This gorgeous house has well-designed bedrooms that follow a coastal theme. Each bedroom is equipped with high-quality linens, comfortable bedding, and plenty of natural light. The primary king suite, located on the second floor, is a luxurious escape. It features a king-size bed and a private ensuite that includes a shower, a large soaking tub, and a private water closet. This room also boasts a spacious private balcony with a stunning water view, providing a serene outdoor space for relaxation. This primary suite offers guests a truly enchanting and rejuvenating retreat. One of the most enticing features of Just B is its proximity to the beach. In just a 3-minute walk, you can find yourself on the pristine shores of Grayton Beach. With its sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters, the beach offers a perfect setting for sunbathing, swimming, beachcombing, or simply unwinding while enjoying the gentle ocean breeze. Book this amazing property where you can unwind and Just B. Sleeping Arrangements: SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Private Balcony & Water View. Bedroom 2: Queen Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: 2 Twin over Queen Bunks with Shared Balcony.. Additional Arrangements: Sleeper Sofa THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: King Bed, Twin over Twin Bunk with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
